text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Ramen Jamboree approaching,
I came to scout a well-reputed shop in pursuit of even tastier ramen, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Investigating their deliciousness
...wouldn't that make us 'spies' in the eyes of the shop...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "If our true goal gets exposed...! We really need to be careful with how we approach this...!"
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry that much...

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ......Just the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoe!?

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
…………
...What are you eating?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eh, umm, umm, umm...
S-Swish! And!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...Miso ramen, and...

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: —...It's salt, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees! With salt, pleaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-The shop owner is so intimidating...!
I-If she finds out what we're here for...
she might turn us into menma...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you really think so...? Well then...
Let's pull ourselves together and scout out the kitc—

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: (Glance...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyawaa!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was close...!
They almost caught me checking the chicken bones for the broth...!
choice_data_list: (Surely at least that much is forgivable...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, h-huh? Where's the shopkeeper?
Where did—

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Behind
text_block_list.text: ...Cold water!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaah!? I-I didn't see anything!!
Didn't see didn't see didn't see none none none—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, did I spill the water?!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm so sawwy!!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
!? Don't move!!!!
The ice will make you sli—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeeeee~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I ended up putting on a terrible figure skating show
right inside the shop...!
The shopkeeper must be so angry with meee...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Forget scouting, at this rate it feels like I just came here to be a nuisance... Ugh, I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
...Here's some tea.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Feh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-It's delicious~...!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Dunno why, but you seemed
pretty nervous back there.

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"...Now you should be able to understand the taste of ramen.
Here... miso ramen and salt ramen."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
S-Shopkeeper...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I will gladly...
partaaake of thiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm, that was delicious...!
choice_data_list: That turned out to be a fruitful investigation.
That turned out to be some great research.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hai-ee. I was startled at first, but looking back now—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The text on the menu was large and easy to read, and the napkins and condiments were neatly restocked... It was filled with such subtle, thoughtful care.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Besides, not just the dining tables, but the entire kitchen as far as the eye can see is sparkling clean.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It looks scary at first glance, but...
the more you look at the shop,
the more you can feel the owner's warm personality~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go again. I want to eat there again.
That kind of thoughtful hospitality that makes you feel that way――
that's another secret to its deliciousness!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes—it's the spirit of hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! The mindset I learned today...
I'm surely going to put it to good use in the Way of Ramen!
